column1: Table A-1: U.S. MD-Granting Medical School Applications and Matriculants by School, State of Legal Residence, and Gender, Academic Year 2025-2026

The table below displays the number of 2025-2026 applications and matriculants by U.S. MD-granting medical schools, showing the percent of in state, out of state, women, and men. Please email datarequest@aamc.org if you need further assistance or have additional inquiries.
¹1,066,896 is the number of applications from 54,699 applicants, an average of 19.5 applications per applicant.
²Applicants who reported "Another Gender Identity" and declined to report gender are only reflected in the Total row.
Note: Each academic year includes applicants and matriculants who applied to enter medical school in the fall of the given year. For example, academic year 2025-2026 represents the applicants
and matriculants who applied to enter medical school during the fall of 2025.
